V30 SYNTAX-fv-is-blind measures why the obvious substitute is useless rather than merely weak -- ast.parse(feature_version=) returns the running interpreter's own verdict at every requested version 3.7 through 3.12, so 3.11.15 refuses the rev53 construct 6 of 6 and 3.12.7 accepts it 6 of 6. sys.stdlib_module_names was REFUSED DELIBERATELY: it is a 3.10 API and using it would have raised this file's own API floor without the construct catalog being able to see it, which is the exact blindness V30 exists to report. decisions_log.decision: Increment 5 SHIPPED and committed -- the runtime preflight reports the three things the gate had always assumed, and a probe armed only where the machine agrees with the constant was caught being an assumption
decisions_log.notes: Same landing commit as the previous entry: s19_app cf24e29 (2026-09-03 08:53:39 -0600), NOT on origin/main; flow rev55, shared with increment 4. Work and packet both 2026-08-31, the packet written at the gate before any commit. WHAT SHIPPED: run() now prints three lines before any rule runs -- git and its version against the 2.28.0 floor, the stdout encoding and its errors handler, and whether the filesystem FOLDS CASE, with the volume it was probed on named. All three were ALREADY ASSUMED by rules that ship and NONE was reported: V16, V25, V27 and half the selftest talk to git, so a machine without it collected three separate absences and never the one sentence explaining them; rev49 hardened the streams BECAUSE the selftest could not state a verdict under a stdout it could not encode, and still never printed what the stream IS; and case-folding stood named in the selftest's own tail as the last of two I/O steps left unproven. FIVE GIT STATES, NOT TWO, each owning a marker phrase no other carries -- ABSENT from PATH, PRESENT and UNUSABLE, an unparseable version string, BELOW the floor, and at-or-above. This is the FOURTH time this flow has paid for collapsing two causes into one message (V25's third state, LED-89.17 in _git, LED-89.22 in V8) and the first time it is mechanised rather than remembered. CASE-FOLDING IS A PROBE, NEVER A DERIVATION: it is a property of the machine and no amount of reading the source reaches it, which is precisely why it stood unproven while every other claim in the file was being derived. MEASURED AT THE COMMIT: 565 arms, 0 FAIL, SELFTEST PASSED on both 3.11.15 and 3.12.7; 12 arms attributable to this increment; 14 mutants applied, 14 KILLED, 0 survivors, against a GREEN baseline. TWO THINGS THAT WENT WRONG AND ARE RECORDED RATHER THAN TIDIED. (a) THE PROBE PASSED ITS FIRST BATTERY WHILE BEING AN ASSUMPTION: N7-case-probe-is-assumed replaces the entire probe body with a constant True and SURVIVED all 12 of the first battery's mutants with every arm green, because THIS MACHINE REALLY DOES FOLD CASE, so the arm asserting the verdict is true is satisfied by the constant. The verdict was armed; the mechanism was not; and no case-sensitive volume exists here to substitute for real. Closed by making the filesystem lookup injectable and arming three substituted filesystems: the answer must FOLLOW the lookup, and the lookup must ask for the LOWERCASED name -- the one thing separating a fold probe from a file-was-written probe. N12, written after the fix, dies on exactly that arm. (b) The first version of the negative control was WRONG and measurement replaced it: it asserted the five sentences share no five-word phrase, and they legitimately do, because git-absent and git-below-floor both end with the same consequence. Disjointness is simultaneously too weak, since two at-or-above sentences differing only by a version number are unequal while telling the reader the same thing. It became exactly-one-of-five marker phrases, proven end to end by PRE E2E-git-blinded in a CHILD PROCESS with git filtered off PATH, which asserts shutil.which returns None FIRST -- a negative control over a PATH that still has git on it is the vacuous check this file exists to end. A cross-contamination hazard was found inside the battery itself: CASE-probe-cleans-up first read the SHARED temp directory, so N13's leaked directories would have reddened the arm on the following run and scored the wrong mutant. NO code-reviewer VERDICT EXISTS FOR THIS INCREMENT. Packet: 03-increments/increment-005.md, written 2026-08-31 at the gate.
